detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Cinema is your empire

Start your journey in 1906 in Paris, just after the first screenings by the Lumière brothers, and thrive for more than 100 years of cinematic evolution. Whether managing a small independent cinema or the world's most prestigious theater, every decision you make will shape the future of your business.

Design the cinema of your dreams

In Cinema Theater Tycoon, customization is at the heart of your success. Build and modify every aspect of your cinemas, from floor to ceiling, with hundreds of items. Create unique screening rooms, upgrade your equipment, and choose every detail with precision.

A journey through 100 years of movie magic

Relive the key moments in cinema history. From silent films to modern blockbusters, each era is represented with its movies, technologies, and trends. Cult classics, world premieres, and seasonal events will bring your cinema to life across the decades. Host premieres, masterclasses, and film clubs to attract stars and moviegoers.

Manage, optimize, expand

Manage every aspect of your cinema, from programming to staff, ticket and popcorn prices, and ensure your theaters are always ready for the next big premiere. Send your film buyers across the globe to find THE perfect movie.
